transcript.text: Can you describe the main challenges you encountered while managing the budget of Rs 40,000 for your college Commerce Society's annual fest?

I'm in my final year of BCom at Government College, Mysuru. My final-year project looked at the working-capital cycle of three kirana stores. I visited each store twice, spoke to the owners about when they pay suppliers and when customers pay them, and built an Excel cash-flow template. Two of the three owners now use it weekly. I want a two-year MBA because I can do the bookkeeping, but I don't yet understand how larger companies make financing and pricing decisions.
